title: Nor'Banks Sailing & Watersports
specs: Age Restrictions You must be 16 years old or older and present a photo ID in order to drive your own Jet Ski.
You must be 18 years old or older in order to rent and pay for a Jet Ski.
Tour participants must be in good health, able-bodied and capable of handling their Sea-Doo in these diverse conditions.
All participants must be comfortable in the water and with the idea of climbing on to the back platform of a Sea-Doo in deep water.
Restrictions On tour, we restrict each Sea-Doo to a maximum of 2 passengers and 350 lbs. in ideal conditions.
Children must be at least 10 years old.
All passengers must be comfortable boarding a Sea-Doo in deep water.
Jet Ski Tour: minimum 2 guests per booking.
Participants must be able to fit snugly in the proper size harness, and the combined weight of the 1, 2 or 3 people in your flight typically must be between 100 and 450 pounds.
Our extra-small harness may fit children as small as 35 pounds.

blurb: Nor'Banks Sailing & Watersports has been the Outer Bank's soundfront watersports destination since 1979. We offer jet ski rentals and tours, parasailing, pontoon boat rentals, tubing, wakeboarding and waterskiing, sailing, and tiki boat cruises aboard Calypso, our 37' custom flagship.
extraNote: As we explore the sound we may encounter a variety of conditions including choppy water and hot or cold weather depending on the season. · You may also want to consider extra layers for sun protection and cool weather, as well as cash to tip the crew. · You may choose to fly double or triple, however, the captain may alter your chosen combinations based on your weight and the weather conditions. · It is customary to tip the captain and crew 15-20% for good service. · However do remember we may have to plan around the weather and surface conditions (especially if you want a mild ride). · We will reschedule or refund your charter in the event that it is prevented by inclement weather. · Custom
